name: codex-personal-launcher
description: Local-only macOS launcher for isolated personal ChatGPT account profiles.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && npm run sign:mac
scripts.sign:mac: codesign --force --deep --sign - "dist-app/mac-arm64/Codex Personal Launcher.app" && codesign --verify --deep --strict "dist-app/mac-arm64/Codex Personal Launcher.app"
scripts.verify:isolation: npm run clean && npm run build:main && node scripts/verify-personal-isolation.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run verify:isolation && npm run verify:browser-links && npm run verify:defaults

author: Local personal build based on JqyModi/codex-multi-launcher
